summary: GATX Corporation filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $300 million offering of 5.950% senior notes due November 15, 2036, priced at 99.789% of principal for total public offering price of $299,367,000. Underwriting discount is 0.650% ($1,950,000), with net proceeds of $297,417,000 before expenses. Interest pays semi-annually beginning May 15, 2027. Notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior indebtedness, redeemable at the company's option, with a change-of-control repurchase provision. Settlement expected November 6, 2026, via DTC book-entry. Joint book-runners are BofA Securities, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley and PNC. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing conditions rather than event arbitrage.
